meta.name: skill-creator
meta.description: Create, refine, and benchmark agent skills. Use when building a new skill, updating an existing one, running evals, checking trigger quality, or improving a skill description.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、优化和评测 agent 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建或改进 agent 技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, refine, and benchmark agent skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build or improve agent skills

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步创建、测试和改进技能。它会帮你写技能描述、生成测试用例、运行对比评估，并根据结果反复优化技能。
howto.when: 当你说要创建新技能、改进现有技能、运行评估或优化技能触发条件时，Claude 会主动介入并引导你完成整个过程。

say.text: 帮我创建一个技能，把Markdown文件转成PDF。
say.note: Claude 会询问细节并起草技能文件。

say.text: 改进我已有的技能，让它触发更准确。
say.note: Claude 会运行评估并建议修改。

say.text: 给这个技能写几个测试用例。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试提示并保存到 evals.json。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through creating, testing, and improving skills step by step. It helps write skill descriptions, generate test cases, run comparative evaluations, and iteratively refine the skill based on results.
howto.when_en: When you say you want to create a new skill, improve an existing one, run evaluations, or optimize skill triggering, Claude will proactively step in and guide you through the process.

say_en.text: Create a skill that converts Markdown files to PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and draft the skill file.

say_en.text: Improve my existing skill to trigger more accurately.
say_en.note: Claude will run evaluations and suggest modifications.

say_en.text: Write a few test cases for this skill.
say_en.note: Claude will generate test prompts and save them to evals.json.
